analysis.summary: A short excerpt introducing an author's experience building automated pull request (PR) reviewers with coding agents. The author argues that architecture matters more than the model, but the excerpt provides no implementation details or supporting evaluation.
keyFindings: The author reports building a couple of versions of automated PR reviewers.
The author characterizes the AI component as surprisingly small and emphasizes architecture over model choice; these are experiential claims rather than demonstrated findings.
limitations: Only a brief introductory excerpt is available, not the full post.
No architectural details, model specifications, evaluation methods, or performance results are provided.
The author's experience does not establish the general superiority of architecture over model choice.

claims.text: The author has built a couple of versions of automated PR reviewers.
claims.evidence: Self-report in the excerpt; no implementations or independent verification are provided.
